description: IN-PT-KA-001 (ZP-TAX-IN-2026-27-001 §21) — Karnataka Professional Tax, salary ₹30,000/month. Karnataka's real bracket schedule (source IN-KA-PT-SCHED / IN-KA-PT-2026-ACT, already seeded in hardcoded_defaults.py) is: ₹0 up to ₹24,999, ₹200 at ₹25,000 and above. ₹30,000 falls in the second tier → professional_tax = ₹200, matching the doc's own stated figure exactly.
source: ZP-TAX-IN-2026-27-001 §21 IN-PT-KA-001 + §13.1 (Karnataka PT schedule, source IN-KA-PT-SCHED/IN-KA-PT-2026-ACT).
